gap_records.statement: The 166 ms shellLatencyMs is a single aggregate spanning stable physical-id resolution and SurfaceControl.setDisplayPowerMode; current telemetry cannot attribute it.
gap_records.why_matters: Optimization choice depends on whether Duo lookup/scheduling or platform/HWC blocking dominates.
gap_records.current_evidence: queue ~0.904 ms; shell ~166 ms; physical-id priming exists and old/current wake primitive is identical.
gap_records.missing_evidence: per-stage resolvePhysicalMs, tokenLookupMs, setPowerModeMs and correlated SF/HWC timestamps.
gap_records.cheapest_decisive_test: Add shell-side monotonic timestamps around resolveFold7InnerPhysicalDisplayId(), getPhysicalDisplayToken, and setDisplayPowerMode, then repeat warm/cold opening on Fold7.
gap_records.duplication_risk: low; slot01 owns historical last-good archaeology, not phase decomposition
gap_records.blocker_status: device timing needed only for final quantification; source instrumentation can be designed now

gap_records.statement: Duo treats synchronous setDisplayPowerMode return as shell completion, but Android 16 SurfaceFlinger waits on scheduler/main-thread work and HWC power transition.
gap_records.why_matters: Moving work between app coroutines will not remove a platform-side wait if that dominates.
gap_records.current_evidence: Android 16 SurfaceFlinger setPowerMode schedules physical power handling then future.wait(); current Duo call is synchronous Binder.
gap_records.missing_evidence: Samsung Fold7 vendor HWC duration and whether an earlier/async request is safe under native cover policy.
gap_records.cheapest_decisive_test: Trace SF/HWC setPowerMode duration alongside Duo timestamps; do not alter close path.

gap_records.statement: Current wake primitive is identical to fast 1.3.29, so regression likely lies outside the primitive: when it is issued, concurrent display mutations, or changed platform state.
gap_records.why_matters: Avoid replacing a historically proven wake primitive.
gap_records.current_evidence: byte-for-byte equality for Shizuku wakeInnerDisplay(), DuoShellService wakeInnerPhysicalDisplay(), resolveCoverDisplay() priming, and FoldOverlayService primeCoverRoute().
gap_records.missing_evidence: whether Gen4 cover mutation activity overlaps wake and whether field fast lineage had lower SF/HWC duration.
gap_records.cheapest_decisive_test: Record coverMutationExecutor phase/queue and wake stage timestamps on the same elapsedRealtimeNanos timebase during opening.
